title: The 10 Best Pool Covers You Can Walk On
h1: The 10 Best Pool Covers You Can Walk On
metaDescription: Our 10 picks for pool covers you can walk on, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at pool covers you can walk on using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: WaterWarden Premium Pool Safety Cover for 18x36 Ft In-Ground Pool with Right Step
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-certified solid vinyl construction, UL-classified for safety cover use, Built-in right step cutout for pool access.
strengths: 20-year warranty is the longest backing of any cover in this roundup, reflecting confidence in the vinyl and hardware
Right step cutout allows pool access without pulling the entire cover off and back on
Highest rating (4.6) among the walk-on covers here, with a substantial 198-review base
limitations: Solid vinyl blocks all sunlight, requiring a cover pump whenever rainwater accumulates on top
Custom-fit sizing and step placement means longer lead time and less flexibility than a stock mesh size
Heavier vinyl panel is harder for one person to remove and store than a mesh cover of the same dimensions
features: Built-in right step cutout for pool access

products.name: WaterWarden Pool Safety Cover for 16x32 Ft Inground Pool with 4x6 Step, Blue Mesh
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-certified polypropylene mesh, 4x6 ft step cutout sized for standard ladders, Full perimeter brass anchor system.
strengths: Self-draining mesh means the walking surface never has standing rainwater sitting on it, unlike a solid cover
4x6 step cutout matches the footprint of a standard inground pool ladder or step system
Lighter mesh material is easier for one person to remove and refit than a solid vinyl cover of the same size
limitations: Mesh still lets fine debris and pollen through, unlike a solid cover's full barrier
Step cutout position is fixed at manufacture, so it only fits pools with a matching step layout
Smaller review base than the larger rectangular WaterWarden and GLI covers in this roundup
features: 4x6 ft step cutout sized for standard ladders
Blue mesh, sized for 16x32 ft inground pools

products.name: WaterWarden Inground Pool Safety Cover 20x40 Ft Rectangle, Blue Mesh
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-certified polypropylene mesh, 20x40 ft rectangular sizing, Full perimeter brass anchor system.
strengths: Largest standard rectangle sizing (20x40) in this roundup, sized for full-scale inground pools
Highest review count (305) of the WaterWarden mesh covers, the strongest large-pool track record here
Self-draining mesh eliminates the standing-water pump maintenance a solid cover this size would require
Anchor system distributes the ASTM-rated load evenly across a longer perimeter span
limitations: Larger span means more anchor points to install and maintain correctly for full rated support
Mesh still allows fine debris through, needing periodic bottom vacuuming despite the cover
No step cutout in this specific configuration, requires pulling the cover fully for pool access

products.name: WaterWarden Inground Pool Safety Cover 18x36 Ft with Center End Step, Green Mesh
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-certified polypropylene mesh, Center end step cutout, Full perimeter brass anchor system.
strengths: Center end step placement suits pools with a mid-span entry point rather than a corner step
Self-draining mesh keeps the walking surface dry between rain events without a cover pump
Green mesh tone is a practical alternative for owners who don't want the more common blue finish
Same ASTM F1346 certification and brass anchor system as the larger WaterWarden mesh covers
limitations: Smallest review base (87) of the WaterWarden covers in this roundup
Fixed center-step position only fits pools with a matching step layout
Slightly lower rating (4.4) than the other WaterWarden mesh configurations here
features: Green mesh, sized for 18x36 ft pools

products.name: GLI Secur-A-Pool 20x40 Ft Rectangular Mesh Safety Cover with Center End Step
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-certified polypropylene mesh, Stainless steel and brass hardware, Center end step cutout.
strengths: Stainless steel and brass hardware resists corrosion better than lower-grade anchor hardware over years of exposure
Center end step cutout provides pool access without removing the full cover
Solid 187-review base backs consistent GLI build quality at large-pool sizing
limitations: Large 20x40 span requires more anchor points, adding installation time and cost
Mesh construction still lets fine debris and pollen settle to the pool floor
GLI covers typically require professional measurement for a correct custom fit, less DIY-friendly than off-the-shelf sizes

products.name: GLI Secur-A-Pool 14x28 Ft Rectangular Mesh Safety Cover
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-certified polypropylene mesh, Stainless steel and brass hardware, 14x28 ft rectangular sizing.
strengths: Same ASTM-rated construction as the larger GLI covers, scaled down for plunge pools and small rectangles at lower hardware cost
Fewer anchor points than a full-size pool cover means a faster, less expensive install
Self-draining mesh avoids the standing-water pump maintenance a solid cover of the same size would need
Stainless and brass hardware holds up to years of outdoor exposure without rusting
limitations: Smallest review base (74) of the GLI covers in this roundup
Not usable on a pool larger than its rated 14x28 footprint without a different size order
No step cutout option in this specific listing

products.name: WaterWarden Solid Vinyl Pool Safety Cover, Fits 18x36 Ft Rectangle
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-certified solid vinyl construction, Fully opaque, blocks all light and debris, Full perimeter brass anchor system.
strengths: Fully opaque vinyl blocks 100% of light, the most effective option here for preventing algae growth over winter
Blocks all debris rather than just the larger particles a mesh weave stops
Same ASTM F1346 load rating as the mesh options, so it supports the same walk-on capacity
limitations: Requires an automatic or manual cover pump to remove standing rainwater, unlike self-draining mesh
Heavier vinyl material is more difficult for one person to remove and store than mesh
Standing water accumulation on top temporarily compromises the dry walking surface even though the structure remains rated
features: Fully opaque, blocks all light and debris

products.name: WaterWarden Inground Pool Safety Cover 20x42 Ft Rectangle, Blue Mesh
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-certified polypropylene mesh, 20x42 ft extended rectangular sizing, Full perimeter brass anchor system.
strengths: 20x42 sizing extends a couple feet beyond the standard 20x40 span, useful for pools with an irregular deck overhang
Self-draining mesh keeps the extended surface free of standing water between rain events
Same brass anchor hardware and ASTM load rating as the standard-size WaterWarden mesh covers
Extended coverage reduces gap exposure at the edges compared to sizing down to the nearest standard dimension
limitations: Lower rating count (96) than the standard 20x40 WaterWarden mesh cover
Non-standard sizing may mean a longer lead time to manufacture than a stock size
Larger surface area means more anchor points requiring correct tensioning for full rated support

products.name: GLI Secur-A-Pool 18x36 Ft Rectangular Mesh Safety Cover with Center End Step
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-certified polypropylene mesh, 18x36 ft rectangular sizing, Center end step cutout.
strengths: 18x36 sizing covers the most common inground pool footprint without paying for 20x40 extended coverage
Center end step cutout adds access convenience without a custom order
Self-draining mesh avoids the pump maintenance a solid cover this size would require
limitations: Mesh still lets fine debris and pollen through to the pool floor
Step cutout is fixed at manufacture, only fits pools with a matching center-end step
Not sized for pools larger than 18x36 without ordering a different configuration

products.name: WaterWarden Premium Pool Safety Cover for 12x20 Ft In-Ground Pool
products.blurb: Key specs: ASTM F1346-certified solid vinyl construction, UL-classified for safety cover use, Full perimeter brass anchor system.
strengths: Highest review count (412) of any product in this roundup, the strongest track record for small/medium pools
Same UL classification, ASTM F1346 certification, and 20-year warranty as the larger Premium WaterWarden cover
12x20 sizing keeps hardware and anchor count lower than a full-size rectangular pool cover
Solid vinyl fully blocks light and debris, reducing algae growth over an off-season closure
